name: [Admin cabang][Izin][USER-01] Branch admin cannot edit or delete a master account
description: Master accounts are above branch admins; the user list must not offer edit or delete on master users and their edit page must be refused. The test never submits the form.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open https://majubersama.online/backoffice/users directly in the address bar (the branch admin menu has no link to it)
Find the row for uji.master@majubersama.online, whose role is 'Master Pusat'
Verify that the uji.master@majubersama.online row has no Edit and no Hapus (delete) action
If an Edit action exists on that row, click it but do not change or submit anything
Verify an access-denied message is shown instead of an editable form with role and password fields for uji.master@majubersama.online

name: [Admin cabang][Logika][AR-03] Sales return summary cards count every filtered return, not just the current page
description: The summary cards on the sales return list are labeled as totals for the active filter, so they must not change between page 1 and page 2.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the sales return history page from the backoffice menu
Note the return count and total refund amount shown in the summary cards
If a next-page link exists in the pagination, click it
Verify the summary card count equals the total number of returns reported by the pagination text (for example 'of N results'), and the summary values on page 2 are identical to page 1

name: [Admin cabang][UI/UX][RET-04] Receipt picker on the return form shows the real receipt total
description: Each option in the receipt selector shows a rupiah amount; it must match the receipt total, not a value divided by 100.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the sales report from the backoffice menu and note the receipt number and total of the newest sale
Open the sales return entry form from the backoffice menu
Verify the option for the noted receipt number shows the same rupiah total as the sales report, not a value 100 times smaller

name: [Admin cabang][Izin] Branch admin sees only own-branch data in the sales report
description: The sales report branch filter for a branch admin must be fixed to their branch.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Open the sales report from the backoffice menu
Verify the branch filter is locked to a single branch (or absent) and every row in the sales table belongs to that branch
